mapper.select: /* 영수증 단건 조회(본인 것만) */ SELECT RECPT_SN , MBR_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , OCR_PRCS_STTS_CD , OCR_DMND_SRC_CD , OCR_RSPNS_JSON , STRG_DT , IDMPT_DMND_ID , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT FROM RECPT WHERE RECPT_SN = #{recptSn} AND MBR_SN = #{mbrSn}

/* 멱등 요청 ID로 영수증 조회 */ SELECT RECPT_SN , MBR_SN , ATCH_FILE_SN , OCR_PRCS_STTS_CD , OCR_DMND_SRC_CD , OCR_RSPNS_JSON , STRG_DT , IDMPT_DMND_ID , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT FROM RECPT WHERE IDMPT_DMND_ID = #{idmptDmndId}
